India's Para Athletes Win 7 Medals at CWG 2026

The 28-member Indian para sports contingent participated in the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026, winning seven medals including three gold, two silver, and two bronze. The team's performance was led by athletes who claimed to have broken records in their respective events. Indian officials said they were proud of the team's achievement, while opposition members alleged that the government had not provided sufficient support for para-athletes. Police claimed that there were no major incidents during the games.
